title: Ịhazi usoro ihe dị ukwuu: nkọwapụta, ikike na ihe

say: Ịhazi usoro ihe dị ukwuu: nkọwapụta, ikike na ihe.
Nke a bụ vidiyo maka modul 1 nke nnukwu mmepụta atụmatụ.
Mgbe iwu bụ 50 ma ọ bụ 100 ugboro ị na-emebu, ihe ise na-agbanwe otu oge. Nke mbụ, ihe ndị ị zụrụ tupu ị nweta ihe ọ bụla.

say: Dị ka ọmụmaatụ, Kemi na-eme plantain chips na Ibadan. Usoro izu ụka nkịtị bụ ngwugwu 40. Otu ụlọ ọrụ na-arịọ maka ngwugwu 5,000 maka ihe mgbochi ndị ọrụ. Nke ahụ bụ usoro ya ugboro 125.

panel.heading: Kemi: site na ngwugwu 40 ruo 5,000
items: 5,000/40 = ugboro 125 usoro ya
Plantain: 5,000 x 0.30 n'arọ = 1,500 n'arọ
Mmanụ: 5,000 x 0.025 = 125 lita
Nchekwa: 5,000/50 = 100 katọn

say: Ekwula okwu n'ụbọchị gị kacha mma. Were elekere elekere ekwentị gị were nkeji nzọụkwụ ọ bụla, ugboro atọ, wee jiri nkezi.
Nzọụkwụ kasị dị nwayọọ bụ mkpọda. Maka Kemi, ighe na ngwugwu 80 n'otu elekere na-edozi ọsọ ọsọ maka ahịrị ahụ dum.

panel.heading: Tinye ndị a na ngwa gị

cards.d: Mgbakwunye nkeji maka samples na jụrụ. Kemi na-ezube 2%, yabụ ngwugwu 5,100 maka 5,000.
Ọnwụ tupu otu nkeji adị, dị ka plantain e merụrụ emerụ. Kemi na-agbakwunye 5% na plantain.
Obere akpa furu efu site na akara ọjọọ ma ọ bụ mpempe akwụkwọ na-ezighi ezi. Kemi na-agbakwunye 3% na obere akpa na akara.

say: Ihe mkpofu ihe bụ mfu tupu otu unit adị. Kemi na-agbakwunye 5% na plantain, ya mere ọ na-azụta ihe dịka 1,607 kg.

say: A na-ebu ụzọ nye iwu ihe ndị nwere ogologo ndu dị ka obere akpa e biri ebi, akwụkwọ mmado na katọn, ozugbo nkwụnye ego rutere ma kwadoo ihe osise ahụ. Akpa e biri ebi nwere ike were ụbọchị ọrụ 10.

Onye ọ bụla ụbọchị tupu ojiji

say: Ihe ndị na-emebi emebi ekwesịghị ịbata n'ụbọchị mbụ. Kemi na-azụta plantain n'ihe dị ka kilogram 400, kwa ụbọchị tupu achọrọ ya.
Lelee nnyefe ọ bụla megide nkọwapụta gị tupu ịbanye ma ọ bụ kwụọ ụgwọ.

say: Ịkwanye ọkpọ ọkpọ ike bụ ebe ihe mberede na-eme. Debe ite mmanụ ihe kariri ihe dị ka otu ụzọ n'ụzọ atọ, ahapụla ya n'echeghị ya nche, debe akwa mkpuchi ọkụ, wụsakwa mmiri n'ọkụ mmanụ.
Debe ihe oriri n'ala ma kpuchie ya.
Ma hapụkwala ngwongwo ruo mgbe ịkwụ ụgwọ rutere na akaụntụ gị, ọ bụghị naanị nseta ihuenyo ma ọ bụ ọkwa SMS.

say: Icheta. Dee mpempe akwụkwọ nkọwa ma debe ihe nlele ọla edo.
Mee atụmatụ na ọnụego gị na-adịgide adịgide. Tinye ohere ma gbakọta. Buru ụzọ tụọ ihe ndị nwere ogologo ụzọ, ndị na-emebi emebi n'ọtụtụ.
